From: AWS Marketplace Partner Ops <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Required security artifacts for Acme Retail listing

Hi Priya,

Thanks for working with us on the Acme Retail listing. Before we can publish the listing to AWS Marketplace and enable the Managed Co-Sell track, we need the following artifacts:

- SOC 2 Type II summary or SOC attestation letter (high-level summary acceptable; full report behind NDA)
- Penetration test attestation letter (signed by vendor)
- Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or confirmation of an existing DPA
- Point of contact for a short verification call (30 minutes)

Target ETA for receipt: week of Jun 23 to keep the June 30 publication target. Please upload documents to the secure folder or send via vendor email. See attached checklist for details.

Attachment: marketplace_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)

Appreciate a quick confirmation of timeline.

Best,
Karen Park

aws-marketplace@amazon.com
